shark-bikini-top.item_description: This top is composed of single crochet cups, featuring color changes which create a shark print. Instructions for the button eyes are provided.
Materials: Size 3 yarn: Light Grey, Dark Grey, Red, White, Black, Blue

elenys-bikini-bottoms.item_description: These bottoms are formed by a combination of single crochet and increase stitches. Instructions to create a gusset are provided, ensuring maximum security.

starfish-bikini-top.item_description: This top is composed of single crochets to form the cups, and a combination of stitches worked into a magic ring to form the starfish. Instructions to work buttons into the work are also provided.

elenys-wave-shrug.item_description: This top is formed by joining wave shaped granny squares, then working above andvbelow with a variety of stitches to create a mesh style detail.
Materials: Size 3 yarn: Blue, Light Blue, White, Cream

knit-microshorts.item_description: These shorts are knit using German Short Rows to shape the shorts to be even in the front and the back. A gusset is created to add maximum coverage and security.
Materials: Size 5 eyelash yarn or Size 4 yarn held with mohair
